_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Inti Player {player_id} f'logħba {num_players}-player tal-Liar's Dice.
Regoli:
- Fit-tieqa tiegħek, inti tista' tagħmel:
  1) Joffra bid ġdid b'kwantità ogħla jew faċċ ogħla (jew iż-żewġ) minn l-offerta attwali; p.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Sejjieħ l-aħħar offerta billi tippenja '[Call]'.

Jekk inti sejjieħ:
  - Jekk il-kont attwali ta' valur faċċi ta' dik il-faċċ huwa inqas mill-offerta, l-aħħar li joffri tilef die waħda.
  - Inkella, il-sejjieħ tilef die waħda.
Player li jilħaq 0 dice huwa eliminat. L-aħħar player li jibqa' jirbaħ.

board.new_round:
Rawnd ġdid - Dadi li baqgħu: {dice_summary}
Id-dadi tiegħek attwali huma: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} jsejjaħ! Il-kont attwali tal-faċċ {face_value} huwa {count}, li huwa INQAS minn {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (l-aħħar li joffri) tilef die waħda.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} jsejjaħ! Il-kont attwali tal-faċċ {face_value} huwa {count}, li huwa >= {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (il-sejjieħ) tilef die waħda.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Ssejjaħ mingħajr ebda offerta minn qabel.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Azzjoni mhux rikonoxxuta bħala '[Bid: X, Y]' valida jew '[Call]'. Azzjoni sottomessa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Il-kwantità l-ġdida {new_quantity} hija inqas mill-ammont attwali {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Il-valur nominali l-ġdid {new_face_value} huwa inqas mill-prezz attwali {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.face_range: Il-valur nominali għandu jkun bejn 1 u 6.
